description: RTA Routes is a dataset listed in City of New Orleans open data portal (data.nola.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New Orleans. The original GTFS file can be downloaded at Included:Routes: Line geometry representing the transit routesStops: Point locations of transit stops, including attributesThe data provided is for informational purposes only and may be subject to change without notice. Coverage: New Orleans. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Infrastructure. Its tags are rta, bus routes, public transit, routes. The table has 14 columns. Attribution on the portal: Regional Transit Authority (RTA). The portal shows 2025-01-17 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-nola-gov-portal.
